source_lines.ordinary_shares: Charter dated 21 April 2026, section 5.2: 87,879,167,190 fully placed ordinary shares at 1 UZS each. Reconciled to OpenInfo Q3 filing 18989, Form 1 line 410: 87,879,167 thousand UZS of closing charter capital.
